subject: using hiphop for coral parentage analysis

messages.author: bc7c55aab5e5f172
messages.subject: using hiphop for coral parentage analysis
parts: Hi there, I am a researcher based at James Cook University in Townsville Australia. I came across your package as I am scoping options to analyse coral SNP data. In short, I have sperm samples from all potential fathers of a mass coral spawning event, and would like to trace the "success" of each father across a time series of developing coral larvae. I am following the vignette for your package, and have gotten stuck at the inspect() stage. The command runs without error, but comes back with a non-sensical result; that 0/549 samples are "sampled" and all samples have 100% missing data. Curious if you can help me troubleshoot. I look forward to hearing from you! Warmest regards, Hillary

messages.author: d838fe8403236eb2
messages.subject: Re: using hiphop for coral parentage analysis
parts:
Hi Hillary, it is a bit hard for me to identify the issue without some example data to reproduce the error you are getting.
Having said that, this sounds like it should be easy to resolve. Also, I am now based at James Cook University in Townsville as well, so if it makes things easier, you could also drop by my office some time next week... room number and contact details can be found here https://research.jcu.edu.au/portfolio/martijn.vandepol/
Martijn
